quarterly_data.quarter: Time Interconnect Technology press release: Interim Results Announcement for the Six Months Ended 30 (08-28-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: H1 2026 (six months ended June 30, 2026) results: revenue HK$10,066.1 million, up 107.4% (HK$4,853.7 million a year earlier), mainly from the DJC Group copper-wire acquisition (December 2025) and higher server and data-centre cable assembly revenue; gross profit margin 12.6% (13.2%), lower because of the lower-margin copper wire sector; profit for the period HK$827.8 million, up 163.9%. More than 50% of revenue was AI-driven, spanning data centre fibre cable assemblies, high-speed cables and servers. Segment revenue: cable assembly HK$2,077.9 million, digital cable HK$782.9 million, server HK$4,314.5 million, copper wire HK$2,890.8 million.
quarterly_data.figure: Revenue HK$10,066.1 million (+107.4%); profit HK$827.8 million (+163.9%); more than 50% of revenue AI-driven

quarterly_data.quarter: Time Interconnect Technology press release: Interim Results Announcement for the Six Months Ended 30 (08-28-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Data centre fibre cable assemblies: revenue HK$1,156.3 million in H1 2026, up 22.8% (HK$941.4 million), still the highest revenue sector in cable assembly. Entering Q2 2026 the business reached a record high in orders and the company continued to expand production capacity in the PRC and Vietnam to meet the rapidly growing order volume; orders were maintained at a very high shipment level. Double density MPO and multi-core fiber panel achieved mass production, raising average selling price and margins. The company shifted telecom production capacity towards the data centre sector, keeping only higher-margin telecom products. AI also drove high-speed cables in the specialty cable sector: revenue HK$162.8 million, up 19.9%, at a better margin.
quarterly_data.figure: Data centre cable assembly revenue HK$1,156.3 million (+22.8%); specialty cable HK$162.8 million (+19.9%)

quarterly_data.quarter: Time Interconnect Technology press release: Interim Results Announcement for the Six Months Ended 30 (08-28-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Outlook (company): as hyperscaler capex accelerates and networks become more fibre-intensive, the company aims to move up from MPO assemblies to higher-density solutions; within data centre fibre cable assemblies it is expanding its customer footprint to more global and domestic CSP customers beginning this year through plants in the PRC, Vietnam, Mexico and Turkey, and extending its range from scale-out to scale-up products, including super-complex fibre shuffle boxes (high-density passive components for any-to-any full-mesh fibre routing in multi-plane AI cluster networks) and next-generation high-density fibre connectivity. The Directors say the company is 'one of the rare suppliers capable of providing these MPO products to Tier-One customers' (company claim).

quarterly_data.quarter: Time Interconnect Technology press release: Interim Results Announcement for the Six Months Ended 30 (08-28-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Leoni LCS Group (Leoni Kabel and subsidiaries) became wholly owned on 31 July 2026 when the company bought the remaining 51% of Time Interconnect Singapore; Leoni LCS is margin-accretive, with manufacturing across Europe, North America, North Africa and Asia, and a new Morocco factory will ramp up in the second half of 2026. The company will broaden Leoni LCS's product range, beginning with 800V DC liquid-cooled power cable for high-current power delivery in AI data centres, and will use Leoni LCS's footprint to expand its data centre cable assembly customer base. H1 2026 share of Time Singapore and Leoni LCS results: net HK$165.4 million.
quarterly_data.figure: Share of Time Singapore / Leoni LCS results HK$165.4 million

quarterly_data.quarter: Time Interconnect Technology press release: Interim Results Announcement for the Six Months Ended 30 (08-28-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Copper wire (DJC Group, acquired December 2025): H1 2026 copper wire revenue HK$2,890.8 million; DJC supplies copper wire for the group's own cable products and to other customers, and currently supplies copper wire products to the Luxshare Group (Luxshare Precision Industry, the company's controlling shareholder, and its subsidiaries), a supply maintained after completion. Average copper price was USD13,083 per ton in H1 2026, up 38.7%; selling prices adjust automatically with copper, so the impact is passed through to customers.
quarterly_data.figure: Copper wire revenue HK$2,890.8 million; average copper price USD13,083 per ton (+38.7%)

quarterly_data.quarter: Time Interconnect Technology press release: Interim Results Announcement for the Six Months Ended 30 (08-28-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: H1 2026 capital expenditure: HK$149.3 million invested in machinery and equipment, leasehold improvements, office equipment and manufacturing environment; capital commitments contracted but not provided for HK$68.4 million at June 30, 2026 (HK$26.3 million at end-2025). Headcount 9,520 at June 30, 2026 versus 6,699 a year earlier, driven mainly by new production staff for data centre cable assembly and servers and the DJC acquisition.
